[ITST.6.3] Checklist for a new spec test:

1. Create `runtime/tests/libds/spec/test_<area>_spec.c`, one binary
   per spec area ([ISTS.8.3]).
2. Include `spec_common.h`, and no project header but it and
   `libds.h` ([ISTS.2.1]).
3. Name each scenario function for the clause it covers,
   `test_<lowercased_id>__<short_tag>` ([ITST.5.3.1]); where the clause
   admits more than one valid implementation, follow [ISTS.4].
4. Write `main()` per [ITST.5.4] and [ITST.5.7].
5. Add a row for the test to the `SpecTest` table in
   `libds.build`. A `test_*.c` with no row is neither built
   nor run.
